title: Thiophosphate Bioisosteres of Inositol Hexakisphosphate Enhances Binding Affinity and Residence Time to Bacterial Virulence Factors.

Inositol phosphates are essential for mammalian cell signalling with critical roles in cellular processes. The fully phosphorylated inositol phosphate, myo-inositol hexakisphosphate (IP6), modulates numerous eukaryotic proteins and bacterial virulence factors....
